Class NetworkSetter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.network.NetworkSetter
public class NetworkSetter extends Object
Helper used by the client side to establish a connection over the desired transport (RMI or socket). Also owns the heartbeat service for the RMI transport.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public static VirtualServer connect(String host, String playerName, VirtualView view, String type, int rmiCallbackPort) throws Exception
      Connects the client to the server using the requested transport.
      Parameters:
      host - host of the server
      playerName - desired display nickname
      view - the local VirtualView the server will push to
      type - transport name ("RMI" or "SOCKET")
      rmiCallbackPort - TCP port the RMI client exports its callback object on; 0 lets RMI pick a free random port. Ignored when type is "SOCKET"
      Returns:
      the remote VirtualServer stub
      Throws:
      Exception - on transport failure or for unsupported transports

    • stopHeartbeat

      public static void stopHeartbeat()
      Stops the heartbeat thread, if any was started.
